Messages.Author: waltman's family computer
Messages.Body:
Hypothetical Situation:
Gangrel Bob has three Wolf Companions.
Ventrue Jill is the blocker.
Range: No range is called.
Strikes: Gangrel Bob uses an Ivory Bow for 1 aggrevated damage, Jill uses
Mighty Grappel for 2 damage.
Damage Resolution: Gangrel Bob has a Guardian Angel and Ventrue Jill uses
Skin of Steel (superior).
As it stands, Gangrel Bob takes 1 damage and Ventrue Jill takes 3 damage
(from the Wolf Companions).
My question: Can Ventrue Jill play Pulled Fangs on Gangrel Bob, or does
"Retainer" damage count as damage done by the opposing vampire?
This is all moot because Gangrel Bob has a Skin of Steel, too, but the
question still stands.
-T!mmy, Malkavian clan Monk

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <KNyC3.166$zI3....@iad-read.news.verio.net>,

"waltman's family computer" <rwal...@early.com> wrote:
> Hypothetical Situation:
> Gangrel Bob has three Wolf Companions.
> Ventrue Jill is the blocker.
> Range: No range is called.
> Strikes: Gangrel Bob uses an Ivory Bow for 1 aggrevated damage, Jill
uses
> Mighty Grappel for 2 damage.
> Damage Resolution: Gangrel Bob has a Guardian Angel and Ventrue Jill
uses
> Skin of Steel (superior).
> As it stands, Gangrel Bob takes 1 damage and Ventrue Jill takes 3
damage
> (from the Wolf Companions).
> My question: Can Ventrue Jill play Pulled Fangs on Gangrel Bob, or
does
> "Retainer" damage count as damage done by the opposing vampire?

She can play it. Retainer damage doesn't count for Pulled Fangs, which
only counts damage done by the minion (through strikes or by other
effects that specify that the minion is the one doing the damage).
